shortDescription: Manages VPCs on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: account
options.description: Account the VPC is related to.

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: cidr
options.description: CIDR of the VPC, e.g. 10.1.0.0/16 All VPC guest networks' CIDRs must be within this CIDR. Required on I(state=present).

options.name: clean_up
options.description: Whether to redeploy a VPC router or not when I(state=restarted)

options.name: display_text
options.description: Display text of the VPC. If not set, I(name) will be used for creating.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain the VPC is related to.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the VPC.

options.name: network_domain
options.description: Network domain for the VPC. All networks inside the VPC will belong to this domain. Only considered while creating the VPC, can not be changed.

options.name: poll_async
options.description: Poll async jobs until job has finished.

options.name: project
options.description: Name of the project the VPC is related to.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the VPC. The state C(present) creates a started VPC. The state C(stopped) is only considered while creating the VPC, added in version 2.6.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags. Tags are a list of dictionaries having keys I(key) and I(value). For deleting all tags, set an empty list e.g. I(tags: []).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vpc_offering
options.description: Name of the VPC offering. If not set, default VPC offering is used.

options.name: zone
options.description: Name of the zone.
